spec_provided_observability.name: CSTS register
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Live controller status — RDY, CFS, SHST, NSSRO, PP bits visible via MMIO read at offset 1Ch.

spec_provided_observability.name: Asynchronous Event Request (AER)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Async notification channel for SMART thresholds, error events, namespace attribute notices, firmware activation events, persistent event log notices, etc.

spec_provided_observability.name: SMART / Health Information log (LID 02h)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Critical warnings + temperature + available spare + percentage used + data units read/written + host read/write commands + controller busy time + power cycles + power on hours + unsafe shutdowns + media errors + number of error log entries + warning composite temp time + critical composite temp time + temperature sensors 1..8 + thermal management transitions + total time for thermal management.

spec_provided_observability.name: Error Information log (LID 01h)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-error CIDs, SQID, status field, parameter error location, LBA, namespace, vendor-specific bytes.

spec_provided_observability.name: Firmware Slot Information log (LID 03h)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Active firmware slot + per-slot firmware revision.

spec_provided_observability.name: Changed Namespace List log (LID 04h)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: List of namespaces that have changed since last read.

spec_provided_observability.name: Device Self-test log (LID 06h)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Results of Device Self-test (short/extended) initiated via Admin OPC 14h.

spec_provided_observability.name: Telemetry Host-Initiated / Controller-Initiated logs (LID 07h / 08h)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Vendor-specific telemetry binary blobs for failure analysis.

spec_provided_observability.name: Persistent Event Log (LID 0Dh, NVMe 1.4)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Persistent ring of events for boot-time triage.

test_types.name: Short device self-test
test_types.purpose: Quick (~2 min) confidence test of controller + media accessibility.

test_types.name: Extended device self-test
test_types.purpose: Long (~minutes to hours) media scrub + ECC + power-loss test.

shadow_doorbell_buffer.purpose: In emulated environments (e.g. virtio-nvme, QEMU), allows host to maintain shadow doorbell + event-index buffers reducing MMIO traffic; useful as a debug observation surface in emulation.

scope_observability: PCIe protocol analyzer (e.g. LeCroy Summit, Teledyne LeCroy) is the primary in-circuit observability — captures every TLP, dword by dword.

Some controllers expose vendor-specific Telemetry log dumps (binary blob) retrievable via Get Log Page; Telemetry Host-Initiated (LID 07h) and Telemetry Controller-Initiated (LID 08h) are NVMe-standardized retrieval mechanisms.
Persistent Event Log (LID 0Dh, added in 1.4) provides a power-loss-survivable event ring.
ate_or_dft: NVMe Base 1.4 does not define any ATE / scan / JTAG interface. Controller vendors implement standard digital DFT (scan, MBIST, LBIST) at silicon design time, completely transparent to host software.
notes: Host-side observability is via Get Log Page (Admin OPC 02h) for SMART/Health, Error Information, Firmware Slot, Telemetry, Persistent Event, Endurance Group, Sanitize Status. Asynchronous events are delivered via outstanding AER commands. PCIe AER (Advanced Error Reporting) capability provides link-level error observability via PCIe Configuration Space, independent of the NVMe register set.
